summary: Would amend the Alabama Constitution to make three changes: a vacant Lieutenant Governor seat would be filled by an election in certain circumstances; the Legislature would set the salaries of the Lieutenant Governor and legislative officers; and legislative travel spending would need approval from legislative officers.
what_yes_means: A yes vote makes all three changes: an election to fill a Lieutenant Governor vacancy in certain circumstances, Legislature-set salaries for the Lieutenant Governor and legislative officers, and required sign-off on legislative travel spending.
what_no_means: A no vote keeps the constitution as it is: no required vacancy election, current salary rules, and no travel-spending approval requirement.
